title: Guided Shopping
seo: Guided shopping quiz for online stores
meta: A short question flow that suggests the right products to each shopper, built into your store. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Guided shopping that suggests the right products
overview: Shoppers who are not sure what to pick often leave. We build a guided flow in your store that asks three to five simple questions, such as budget, use and style, and then shows the best matching products. We map answers to your real catalog, write friendly wording and style the widget to match your theme. Before launch, we test every path on phone and desktop, so no answer leads to an empty result.

faq: Is the assistant free to say anything?
No. It only recommends products from your own catalog and uses answers and wording that we write and you approve. This keeps it on topic and avoids made up product claims.
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix and others that allow a widget or app. We confirm what is possible for your platform before we start and use the lightest route that works.
Do I need to pay for an app?
Possibly. Some quiz tools charge a monthly fee, billed by the app maker to you. We tell you the cost before installing, and we can build a simple version in your theme if you prefer.
Not unless you want it to. The email step in Premium is optional and asks for clear consent. We follow your privacy policy and cookie settings, and we do not sell or share the answers.
